subject: Loading RData and Filling selectInput Menus

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Loading RData and Filling selectInput Menus
parts:
Hello,

I'm having trouble using mget and attach to load an RData of unknown variable names, which can then be chosen with a drop-down list. I get "bad 'file' argument". My attempt is :

ui.R
----

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
 
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Cancer"),
 
  navlistPanel("Setup",
    tabPanel("Load Dataset",
             fluidRow(column(5, fileInput("rDataChooser", "Choose A R Data File", accept = "RData"))),
             fluidRow(column(5, selectInput("exprChooser", "Choose An Expression Matrix", choices = NULL))),
             fluidRow(column(5, selectInput("statusChooser", "Choose A Status Vector", choices = NULL))),
             fluidRow(column(5, selectInput("timeChooser", "Choose A Time Vector", choices = NULL)))),
    "Analysis",
    tabPanel("Kaplan-Meier Survival")
  )
))

server.R
-----------

library(shiny)

loadAndList <- function(input)
{
  attach(mget(load(input[["rDataChooser"]][1, "datapath"]), envir = .GlobalEnv))
  ls()
}

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    updateTextInput(session, "exprChooser", value = loadAndList(input))
    updateTextInput(session, "statusChooser", value = loadAndList(input))
    updateTextInput(session, "timeChooser", value = loadAndList(input))
  })
})

I am using shiny 0.11.1.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Loading RData and Filling selectInput Menus
parts:
You have to check if input[["rDataChooser"]] is NULL before you load
the RData file, otherwise it will surely trigger an error if you have
not uploaded the file yet (essentially load(NULL)). You may want to
read this article: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/validation.html

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Loading RData and Filling selectInput Menus
parts:
Thanks for the advice about validation. I thought that it would only fire an event once the file has
completed uploading. I no longer get the error message after adding :

validate(need(!is.null(input[["rDataChooser"]]), "Choose a file."))

into the data loading function.

However, the text input never updates. I have also changed server.R to :

loadRData <- function(input)
{
  validate(need(!is.null(input[["rDataChooser"]]), "Choose a file."))
  melanomaData = new.env()
  load(input[["rDataChooser"]][1, "datapath"], envir = melanomaData)
  melanomaData
}

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    loadRData(input)
    updateTextInput(session, "exprChooser", value = ls())
    updateTextInput(session, "statusChooser", value = ls())
    updateTextInput(session, "timeChooser", value = ls())
  })
})

What have I missed ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Loading RData and Filling selectInput Menus
parts:
You created a new environment new.env() and returned it in
loadRData(), but you did not let ls() know that environment. The
default environment that ls() uses is its calling environment; in your
case, there is basically nothing in the calling environment of ls().
You may assign the environment to a variable, e.g.

env = loadRData(input)

Then pass it to ls() explicitly, e.g. ls(env)

Regards,
Yihui
